sections.advice: Lom → Sognefjellshytta climbs about 1434 m in 53 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.

scenicChapters.title: Lom → Sognefjellshytta
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 54 km. 1434 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall. A steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

scenicChapters.title: Sognefjellet Norwegian Scenic Route
scenicChapters.narrative: Brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace. 1434 m come off over 16 km at around 9.0%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Sognefjellet Norwegian Scenic Route
scenicChapters.narrative: For 37 km this is Sognefjellet Norwegian Scenic Route, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

norwegian-scenic-route-sognefjellet.story: 107 km one way from Fossbergom - plan on about 1 h 45 of riding. On the way it passes Sognefjellshytta and Turtagro. The highest point is about 1,450 m. Sognefjellshytta is open in summer only - check it is open before you set off. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
